title: Studio Data pillar form designer rebuilds ObjectForm's fields array every render — redundant field-list recomputation (no duplicate query)
body:
Observation-class finding, noticed while fixing #4567. Filed unassigned for triage; **not** the same severity as #4567 and deliberately not fixed there (out of that card's surface).

## What it is

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` builds the form designer's `ObjectForm` schema inline, in the same shape #4567 fixed for the grid:

```
fields: readFields(objDraft.fields)
  .entries.map((e) => e.name)
  .filter((n) => !STUDIO_SYSTEM_FIELD_NAMES.has(n)),
```

That allocates a fresh array on every render of the pillar. `ObjectForm` lists `schema.fields` in an effect's dependency array **by identity** (`packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:695`), so the effect re-runs on every render.

## Why this is NOT a #4567

I checked the effect body before filing (`ObjectForm.tsx:500-695`): it is a pure field-list derivation ending in `setFormFields(generatedFields)`. It makes **no** `dataSource` call — the object-schema fetch and the record load are separate effects, and neither depends on `schema.fields`.

So the cost here is a redundant recomputation plus one extra state-set/render pass per pillar render — **not** a duplicate backend query. That is the whole difference from #4567, where the identical inline-array shape sat in `ListView`'s fetch dependency chain and issued a real extra `find()` per render.

It is bounded, not a loop: `setFormFields` re-renders `ObjectForm` only, which does not re-run the parent's render, so `schema.fields` keeps its identity within that cycle.

## Impact

No user-visible defect today. Wasted work on a surface that re-renders at keystroke rate, and a latent hazard: if anything in that effect's dependency chain ever grows a data call, this becomes a #4567 with no code change at the producer.

## Suggested fix

Same producer-side memo as #4567 — hoist to `React.useMemo` keyed on `objDraft.fields` (the tighter key: `onPatch` replaces the draft object while keeping `fields` identical). Note the filter differs from the grid's, which also drops a field named `actions`, so it is a second memo rather than a shared one.

Refs #4567, #4549.
